  WHY: Each affected tick makes one extra bounded, memoized, documented REST read. Fetching the date lazily would avoid it.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: add `return 0` at the end of `_validation_harness_hold_end_park` (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
